30October2026. Root personally constructed the comb model, exact one-query
receiver and rational two-query parallel dual. C independently constructed
the coherent relative-SWAP/Pauli feedback receiver. This is a mathematical
operation/certificate, not a quantum/source experiment or a linear-r theorem.
Pure-isometry endpoints match established inversion results; historical
priority of the mixed-source specialization is UNKNOWN.

## 1. Input and consequence being investigated

For known integers k>=2,r>=1,D>=kr, the SAME unknown memoryless source is

    N_U(X)=U(X tensor I_r/r)U*,  U*:U=I_(kr).

Only ordinary forward uses are supplied. Input registers can be entangled
with retained memory, and later calls may depend coherently on that memory.
No controlled unknown source, adjoint/dilation inverse, environmental flag,
junk intervention or quantum switch is assumed. Known gates, clean ancillas,
measurements and quantum storage are separately paid operations. One already
encoded arbitrary payload must produce a logical output at full throughput.

The target is the native-query gap between explicit quadratic-r recovery and
the physical-query linear lower bound, not a presumed quadratic impossibility.
The early ordinary construction in a_ordinary/FLAT_RDS_RECOVERY.md supplies
O(k^2 r^2/epsilon) offline calls with no online source query, but a consumed
large quantum programme and online gates. Its ideal reflection count is only
O(r); the expensive source-to-reflection supplier is the actual bottleneck.

## 2. Choi and causal conventions

Use UNNORMALIZED channel Choi matrices J_N, Tr_B J_N=I_A. A Q-slot receiver
has a positive comb W on logical output A0, query inputs A1...AQ, query
outputs B1...BQ and encoded payload B0. Full-throughput deterministic causal
trace identities are

    Tr_A0 W = I_BQ tensor W_Q,
    Tr_Aj W_j = I_B(j-1) tensor W_(j-1)  (j=Q,...,2),

single-spin attempts. Root's separately optimized covariant two-query
comb suggested the missing positive-transpose branch. The circuit and
rational receiver here are explicit; root's floating optimal coefficients
are not used as a source oracle or correctness premise.

junk. Controls, Bell preparation and quantum storage are known ideal
operations for this theorem. An arbitrary singly encoded payload may be
entangled with an inaccessible reference. No inverse, source environment,
controlled unknown operation, exposed junk flag or quantum switch exists.

The construction below works at throughput one, with two forward queries
per decoded payload. Its exact rank-two fidelity is low, not a useful

part of the adaptive gain; it does NOT solve the near-linear-r inverse
problem or establish a scaling law by a small-r example. The all-r
source/kernel formula is exact and exposes that next question.

# Same-access comparison: a certified mixed-source adaptive gap

30 October2026. This compares the completed physical-query controller with
the strongest two-query PARALLEL competitor, rather than only normalized
iid Choi programmes. The general linear-r high-accuracy goal remains open.

## 1. What the parallel class is allowed

The source is the same exact flat qubit encoder of rank r=2. Initially take
D=4, arbitrary unknown U in U(4). Allow arbitrary ancillary systems,
arbitrarily entangled logical inputs to the two parallel N_U calls, general
known preprocessing and postprocessing, and coherent quantum programme
storage. A reference-entangled unknown payload is singly encoded by N_U.
No inverse, junk access or quantum switch is supplied to either side.

The covariance reduction does not assume that an arbitrary preprocessor
literally ignores a payload that was already available. Average over the
unknown physical frame. Before either output is received there is only
ONE physical fundamental representation, the payload. The reduced Choi
operator of the preprocessor, after tracing its memory, must commute with
that irreducible U(D) representation and is therefore I_payload tensor a
logical-query state. Stinespring uniqueness moves any remaining coherent
payload/query correlation into known final memory processing. Thus the
parallel normalizer below permits the complete parallel class at this
covariant minimax task. It is stronger than assuming iid Bell programmes.

## 2. The finite exact dual model

Use root's Choi grouping into three logical legs(final output,query1,
query2) and three physical legs(payload,out1,out2). After the left physical
and right logical covariance averages, permutation operators span each
commutant. Let P_s be a logical S3 permutation, Q_t a physical S3
permutation, c(t) its cycle count, and G_D(s,t)=D^[c(s^-1 t)]. The
performance operator is

  Omega=sum_(a,b in S3) (G_D^-1)_(b,a)
                      r^[c(a)-3]/4 * P_a tensor Q_b.      (1)

The normalization is independently fixed by closing a permutation:

  Tr[(P_s tensor Q_t)Omega]
       =2^[c(s t^-1)] r^[c(t)-3]/4.                      (2)

A parallel deterministic comb C is positive and obeys

  Tr_(logical output) C =rho_(query1,query2) tensor I_phys,
  Tr rho=1.

Take a Hermitian Y=I_(logical output) tensor Y0 such that

  Y-Omega>=0,
  Tr_phys Y0<=lambda I_(query1,query2).
